name: Set.Nonempty.ordConnected_iff_of_bdd
statement: I.Nonempty) (h₁ : BddBelow I) (h₂ : BddAbove I) : I.OrdConnected ↔ I = Icc (sInf I) (sSup I)

name: Set.ordConnected_iff_disjoint_Ioo_empty
statement: I.OrdConnected ↔ ∀ᵉ (x ∈ I) (y ∈ I), Disjoint (Ioo x y) I → Ioo x y = ∅

have_tree.name: h₃
have_tree.body: fun t ht ht' ↦ hx''.not_gt (⟨ht', le_trans hx' ht.1.le, ht.2⟩) ht.1

have_tree.name: h₄
have_tree.body: fun t ht ht' ↦ hy''.not_lt (⟨ht', ht.1, le_trans ht.2.le hy'⟩) ht.2
